lean.faithfulness_note: Proves only the list-implies-vanishing direction of the statement. Integers c1..c5 enter through residues in ZMod k; the five shapes (integer parameter, sign eps=+-1) and the ten words are proved to give S_5 = 0 identically in Z[q,q^-1], and the residue step is proved via evaluation at a primitive k-th root. The hypothesis k>=7 of the statement is kept in length5_vanishing but is not needed (length5_vanishing_all holds for every k>1). Completeness of the list (no other word vanishes) is NOT part of this result; see length5-complete.
